repos_data.description: Node.js/TypeScript MCP server for Atlassian Confluence. Provides tools enabling AI systems (LLMs) to list/get spaces & pages (content formatted as Markdown) and search via CQL. Connects AI seamlessly to Confluence knowledge bases using the standard MCP interface.

Node.js/TypeScript MCP server for Atlassian Jira. Equips AI systems (LLMs) with tools to list/get projects, search/get issues (using JQL/ID), and view dev info (commits, PRs). Connects AI capabilities directly into Jira project management and issue tracking workflows.
MCP server for Bitbucket Cloud, focused on pull-request review workflows
A Bitbucket CLI and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server in Go.

Node.js/TypeScript MCP server for AWS Single Sign-On (SSO). Enables AI systems (LLMs) with tools to initiate SSO login (device auth flow), list accounts/roles, and securely execute AWS CLI commands using temporary credentials. Streamlines AI interaction with AWS resources.
MCP server for Bitbucket API operations
Multi-Model chat, code review and analysis MCP Server for Claude Code
MCPBundles .mcpb package releases for MCP registry
Froggit-Go is a universal Go library, allowing to perform actions on VCS providers.

A lightweight service that enables AI assistants to execute AWS CLI commands (in safe containerized environment) through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Bridges Claude, Cursor, and other MCP-aware AI tools with AWS CLI for enhanced cloud infrastructure management.

repo_meta_data.description: Node.js/TypeScript MCP server for Atlassian Bitbucket. Enables AI systems (LLMs) to interact with workspaces, repositories, and pull requests via tools (list, get, comment, search). Connects AI directly to version control workflows through the standard MCP interface.
